title: Evidence Graph
$comment: PROV / ECO / SEPIO crosswalk (advisory; NO ontology is imported and NO RDF is emitted — the bespoke JSON stays canonical). The `chain` edges map onto W3C PROV: a dataset node is a prov:Entity; a card's evidence is a prov:Activity that prov:used the dataset(s) and whose class value prov:wasGeneratedBy the method; a rule is a prov:Activity that prov:used the evidence, and the verdict prov:wasDerivedFrom the driving rule (verdict.driving_rule_id). ECO: the optional card.confidence.eco_id annotates evidence_state with an Evidence & Conclusion Ontology code (measured/comparator -> ECO:0000006 experimental evidence; inferred -> ECO:0000363 imported information used in automatic assertion; data_unavailable -> null). SEPIO framing: each verdict-bearing card is an evidence line (the card node) whose evidence items are its datasets + key_evidence and whose assertion is the fired rule; literature.axes are corroborating/contrasting evidence lines (agreement_vs_omics). These IDs are optional/nullable interoperability hooks only.
description: Schema for the additive, DISPLAY-ONLY claim graph emitted at decision.headline.evidence_graph by a subskill data package. It is a one-way relational projection over data already present in decision.json (verdict spine + cards + fired_rules + subgroup_signals/evidence_capsules + question_table + optional literature_synthesis/llm_synthesis) so downstream renderers read explicit, stably-keyed edges (question <-> card <-> rule <-> dataset <-> literature-axis <-> citation <-> narrative) instead of re-deriving joins. It introduces NO new science and feeds NO rule/resolver/gate. Datasets and citations are deduplicated into id-keyed arrays; every other node references them by id. Referential integrity is an invariant: every id referenced by an edge must resolve to a node in the same package. Fields are widely nullable because the graph is an honest projection: an unmeasured/unbound signal, an axis with no literature, or a question with no cards is emitted with null/empty edges, never dropped.

polarity.description: Canonical display polarity (ordinal_view vocabulary): supportive | neutral | opposing | killer | not_applicable. Nullable when unbound. Not a verdict input.

liability.description: True when this card carries a safety/normal-tissue liability class (polarity is then killer). Orthogonal flag so a renderer can label a liability distinctly from a generic killer without re-deriving it from the class string. Absent on question signals.

eco_id.description: OPTIONAL Evidence & Conclusion Ontology code annotating evidence_state (measured -> ECO:0000006 experimental evidence; comparator -> ECO:0000006; inferred -> ECO:0000363 imported/computational; else null). An advisory interoperability annotation only — no ontology is imported and no RDF is emitted (see the top-level $comment PROV/ECO/SEPIO crosswalk). Nullable; feeds no rule/gate.

key_evidence.description: Bounded, typed promotion of the DECISIVE data points behind this card, projected from the evidence_capsule (top_k_strata / n_basis / categorical_anchors / sibling_caveats / conflict_pairs) plus per-measurement_type-pinned significance fields. ADDITIVE + DISPLAY-ONLY: the grounding substrate for the narrator + card-chain renderer. Full arrays remain only in decision.cards[].summary. All members optional/nullable (an honest projection: absent -> omitted). Feeds NO rule/resolver/gate.

interpretation.description: Typed reference-frame RULER(s) that place this card's decisive number(s) on a scale so a bare metric reads as a gauged statement (e.g. median_chronos -1.18 sits between the non-essential floor -0.04 and the pan-essential ceiling -1.50, past the -0.5 cut). A LIST because one card can carry >1 ruler (amp-expr needs a panel-value gauge AND a stratum-value gauge; the resolver may band on a different value than `effect.value` holds). Populated in Stage 2 from the per-measurement_type SALIENCE_SPEC `reference_frame` (which NAMES summary fields — never recomputes) + the card's resolver class/position field; DORMANT (unemitted) at Stage 1. ADDITIVE + DISPLAY-ONLY: feeds NO rule/resolver/gate. Vocabulary is a superset of claim_record.magnitude (level/value/scale/distance_to_cut) so display + factored record converge (Stage 3).

effect.description: The load-bearing effect for this card (e.g. the indication/strongest stratum's median_chronos, a log2FC, a correlation r, a LOEUF).

direction.description: lower_is_stronger | higher_is_stronger | higher_is_worse | near_zero_is_independent | ... (display hint; not a verdict input).

significance.description: The significance statistic behind the effect (q_value / p_value / mannwhitney_q / LOEUF / pLI). The most-dropped decisive field pre-key_evidence.

omnibus.description: A cross-stratum omnibus test (e.g. lineage_omnibus_p / subtype_omnibus_p). Explicitly pinned; does not rely on the anchor-hint heuristic.

top_strata.description: <=3 salient strata rows (indication + strongest + weakest), each carrying its effect value, n, and q where the row has it.

categorical.description: Decisive non-numeric labels the numeric selectors cannot carry (fit_class, highest_tissue, dep_control_position_class, ...).

n_basis.description: The decisive count(s) behind a categorical/liability verdict (n_pathogenic_germline, n_lethal, ...).

conflict.description: Sibling-card tier disagreement on this measurement_type (from the capsule's conflict_pairs).

subtype_axis.description: Subtype/subgroup-stratified evidence (is the call subtype-restricted, and which subtype?). Null when the subtype axis is absent (--subtypes off) so standard-run graphs stay byte-stable.

gauged_value.description: One typed reference-frame ruler for a single card metric (a member of key_evidence.interpretation[]). Names its OWN metric/value/scale (the gauged number is often NOT effect.value) and unifies the four reference kinds via frame.kind + anchors[].role. ORDINAL layers (level/position) are READ VERBATIM from a resolver *_class field, never recomputed from value-vs-anchors (the effect uses the stratum value while the band used the panel value -> recompute = stored contradiction). Graceful degradation: emit the layers present (a value+scale gauge still beats a bare number). Additive, DISPLAY-ONLY, nullable. 'No bare number': value non-null => scale non-null (enforced by the allOf below).

metric.description: The summary field this ruler gauges (e.g. median_chronos_panel, amp_expr_effect_size).

value.description: The gauged number itself (sig_round'd). NOT necessarily effect.value.

scale.description: The unit/scale the value lives on (chronos, log2fc, percentile, neglog_m, loeuf, ...). Required whenever value is present (no bare numbers).

direction.description: lower_is_stronger | higher_is_stronger | higher_is_worse | near_zero_is_independent | ... (orients the gauge; not a verdict input).

level.description: Ordinal strength bin, byte-aligned with claim_record.magnitude.level, taken from the card's class/strength — NOT thresholded here.

position.description: Categorical band (e.g. between_controls, above_ceiling) READ VERBATIM from a resolver *_class field — never computed from value vs anchors.

position_source.description: The resolver summary field `position` was read from (e.g. dep_control_position_class), for provenance + the align-value-with-band check.

distance_to_cut.description: Signed offset from the decision cut (or a comparator baseline). PREFER surfacing the summary's own delta/distance field over computing value-anchor; compute only from two pinned sig_round'd numbers.

frame.description: The reference frame the value is placed on. kind selects which anchors are meaningful: percentile (min/max implicit) | floor_cut_ceiling (floor/cut/ceiling, uses `position`) | comparator_delta (comparator baseline, offset = distance_to_cut = the delta) | distance_to_cut (cut, signed offset) | graded_band (>=2 ordered cut anchors, e.g. modest+strong, value read against the ladder) | count_of_total (value is a count, a `total` anchor gives the denominator + a `cut` anchor the count threshold, e.g. elevated in 4 of 6 cohorts past the 3 cut).

anchors.description: The named reference points on the frame (a floor, a cut, a ceiling, a comparator baseline, a total denominator). role is the frame slot; value is sig_round'd.

role.description: floor | cut | ceiling | comparator | total | min | max | ...

label.description: The summary field / human label this anchor came from (e.g. non_essential_floor).

allOf.$comment: No bare number: if value is a real number, scale must be a non-null string.

literature.description: Empty object {} when no literature lane; otherwise the projected axes + blind spots.

narrative.description: Empty object {} when no llm_synthesis (or an error/skip stub); otherwise the anchored narration. Stage 2 leads with `exec_bullets` (a short crisp grounded executive summary); `rationale` is the demoted verbose full-narrative prose (renderer shows bullets first, prose behind an expander). Advisory + VERDICT-INERT: never sets the call; goldens must not depend on it (optional, provenance-wrapped trailer).

exec_bullets.description: PRIMARY output (Stage 2): a short list (<=~6) of crisp bullets, each reasoning ACROSS signals and carrying the salient omics + literature data point (from key_evidence + literature axes), anchored to the package. Absent/empty when --synthesize is off.

rationale.description: The demoted verbose 'full narrative' prose (secondary; behind an expander).
